The main takeaway from our work is that

the extract of the legume plant Albizia adinocephaia, which is a tree that is found in Panama and other countries in Central and South America, was able to inhibit the growth of the breast cancer cell line MCF7 (ER+) and the prostate cancer cell line PC3 (AR+) in vitro, and was able to inhibit growth in a HER2+ breast cancer cell line.
